claim: The sample demo opens in one click and stays separate from real captions and settings.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real IndexedDB data; exercise, reset, and leave /demo; compare both storage namespaces

claim: Caption Lanes separates captions into left, centre, and right lanes with manual keyboard placement.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert all three lanes and place a typed caption with the number-key control

claim: A stereo microphone can provide a coarse left, centre, or right hint, and its audio track stops when captions pause.
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded stereo analyser samples; assert the left hint, strong label, and stopped track

claim: The caption demo sends no data to another origin and never requests microphone access.
sandbox: fresh /demo; record every request; add and export a caption; inspect the request origins and microphone call count

claim: Caption Lanes never retains raw microphone audio; only caption fields are stored and exported.
where: landing facts, consent, privacy page, README
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded speech and mono-stream fixtures; assert no MediaRecorder use, stopped track, IndexedDB fields, and export flag

claim: The installed app opens offline after one online visit.
sandbox: new browser context at /demo; install and control the service worker; set context offline; reload the exact demo URL

claim: Real caption text and display settings stay in the browser across reloads until cleared.
where: header, privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; choose Start for real; add a caption; reload; reopen typed captions

claim: Users can export and import caption text as JSON.
where: How it works, Settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; parse the downloaded JSON; import a replacement fixture and assert visible rows

claim: Typed captions ignore blank input and stop at 240 characters.
sandbox: fresh /demo; submit spaces; enter 241 characters; assert zero blank rows and an exact 240-character value

claim: Hide uncertain captions removes results below 60 percent confidence and keeps the 60 percent boundary.
sandbox: fresh /demo; import recorded 0.59 and 0.60 fixtures; enable the filter and compare visible captions

claim: Live speech requires browser-confirmed on-device processing and remains optional because typed captions work without it.
where: consent, offline notice, privacy page, README
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded browser speech fixtures; reject missing processLocally support and assert true when supported

claim: Caption Lanes builds an Android app with a native on-device caption bridge and an instrumented bridge test.
sandbox: clean Android SDK and JDK worker; sync web assets, assemble the debug APK and debug Android-test APK, and compile NativeCaptionBridgeTest

claim: Caption Lanes Plus costs $24 once, adds a fourth lane, and reuses a valid verification for one day.
where: landing facts, paid section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; enter real mode with a recorded valid verification; assert price, checkout URL, four lanes, and one request across reload

claim: Caption Lanes starts speech and microphone access only after the consent checkbox is selected.
where: consent panel, How it works, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh real mode with recorded speech and microphone counters; attempt start before and after consent

claim: Caption Lanes stops its microphone track on pause, end, app navigation, background, and close.
sandbox: fresh real mode with a counted audio-track fixture; exercise every stop path and assert one stop per active track

claim: Caption Lanes uses no account, analytics, or cloud archive service.
where: landing privacy section, consent panel, privacy page
sandbox: fresh demo, real typed, and licensed flows; record all requests and assert only same-origin files plus the named license endpoint

claim: Caption Lanes does not infer or store speaker identities or voiceprints.
where: landing limits, consent panel, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo; add a caption and assert every stored row contains only caption, direction, confidence, source, id, and time fields

claim: A mono microphone shows the automatic-direction limitation while manual placement remains available.
sandbox: fresh real flow with a recorded one-channel track; assert warning, choose Right manually, and place a caption

claim: When a supported browser offers an on-device language pack, Caption Lanes installs it before starting recognition.
sandbox: fresh real flow with recorded downloadable and install responses; assert installation finishes before recognition starts

claim: Typed captions, display controls, confidence filtering, and transcript export remain available without a license.
where: landing Plus section, Plus dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh real mode with no license; type a caption, change size, enable filtering, change a lane color, and export JSON

claim: A valid Caption Lanes Plus license can be restored in a fresh browser.
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts with the same recorded valid token; restore independently and assert four lanes in each

claim: Caption Lanes rechecks a cached license when the device reconnects.
sandbox: fresh real mode with a cached valid verdict; dispatch reconnect with a recorded revoked response and assert the fourth lane closes

claim: The buy link redirects to Sociobot/Dodo hosted checkout, and Caption Lanes does not collect card details.
sandbox: assert the app has no card fields; make five live-safe GET requests without redirects; assert every response is 303 to checkout.dodopayments.com

claim: A revoked or refunded license stops Caption Lanes Plus features.
sandbox: fresh real mode with recorded valid, revoked, and refunded responses; select Across; after each inactive verdict assert the fourth lane closes and Centre is selected
